null: s must be an object whose reader is one of: json, yaml, glob, openapi, references, schema, routes, validator, prolog
array: s must be an object whose reader is one of: json, yaml, glob, openapi, references, schema, routes, validator, prolog
noReader: s must be an object whose reader is one of: json, yaml, glob, openapi, references, schema, routes, validator, prolog
badReader: s must be an object whose reader is one of: json, yaml, glob, openapi, references, schema, routes, validator, prolog
jsonMissingFile: s.file is required for reader json
jsonUnknownKeys: s (reader json) does not take pattern, ignore; it takes reader, file, path, select, field
jsonAbsolute: s.file must be a repository-relative path inside the workspace
jsonParent: s.file must be a repository-relative path inside the workspace
jsonBackslashParent: s.file must be a repository-relative path inside the workspace
jsonBlankFile: s.file must be a repository-relative path inside the workspace
jsonNumberFile: s.file must be a repository-relative path inside the workspace
jsonBadPath: s.path must be a dotted path or a JSON pointer
jsonBlankField: s.field must name the key read from each item of the list
jsonFieldOnKeys: s.field applies only to select items
jsonBadSelect: s.select must be one of: keys, values, items
prologObjectFunctor: s.functor is required for reader prolog: name the facts read as Name/Arity (requires/1)
jsonFieldOnValues: s.field applies only to select items
globMissing: s.pattern is required for reader glob
globEmptyList: s.pattern must be a repository-relative glob or a list of them
globBlank: s.pattern must be a repository-relative glob or a list of them
globAbsolute: s.pattern must be a repository-relative glob or a list of them
globParentInList: s.pattern must be a repository-relative glob or a list of them
globNumber: s.pattern must be a repository-relative glob or a list of them
globBadIgnore: s.ignore must be a repository-relative glob or a list of them
globBadCapture: s.capture must be true or false
globSelect: s (reader glob) does not take select; it takes reader, pattern, capture, ignore
s.select does not apply to reader glob
openapiMissing: s.file is required for reader openapi
openapiBadSelect: s.select must be one of: operations, unsecured_operations, security_schemes, responses
referencesMissing: s.files is required for reader references
s.extract must be one of: env, imports, calls, string_args, thrown, property
referencesBadExtract: s.extract must be one of: env, imports, calls, string_args, thrown, property
referencesStringArgs: s.callee is required for extract string_args: name the function whose first argument is read
referencesBlankCallee: s.callee must be a function name
referencesProperty: s.key is required for extract property: name the property whose string values are read
referencesKeyElsewhere: s.key applies only to extract property
referencesBadIgnore: s.ignore must be a repository-relative glob or a list of them
referencesSelect: s (reader references) does not take select; it takes reader, files, extract, callee, key, ignore
s.select does not apply to reader references
schemaBadFormat: s.format must be drizzle, prisma or sql
schemaDrizzleFiles: s.files applies only to format sql
schemaDrizzleNoFile: s.file is required for reader schema
schemaPrismaExports: s.exports must be a list of export names, for format drizzle only
schemaBadExports: s.exports must be a list of export names, for format drizzle only
schemaSqlNoFiles: s.files is required for reader schema
schemaSqlFile: s.file does not apply to format sql; use files
schemaBlankTable: s.table must be a table name or a glob of table names
schemaBadSelect: s.select must be one of: tables, columns, required_columns, nullable_columns, foreign_keys
routesMissing: s.file is required for reader routes
s.export is required for reader routes: name the app (or a function returning it)
routesBadFramework: s.framework must be hono or express
routesBadPrefix: s.path_prefix must be a path starting with /
routesBlankPrefix: s.path_prefix must be a path starting with /
routesBadNames: s.names_from must list repository-relative module files whose exports name middleware
routesParentNames: s.names_from must list repository-relative module files whose exports name middleware
validatorMissing: s.file is required for reader validator
s.export is required for reader validator: name the object schema
validatorBadSelect: s.select must be one of: fields, required_fields, optional_fields
prologMissing: s.file is required for reader prolog
s.functor is required for reader prolog: name the facts read as Name/Arity (requires/1)
prologUpper: s.functor is required for reader prolog: name the facts read as Name/Arity (requires/1)
prologLeadingZero: s.functor is required for reader prolog: name the facts read as Name/Arity (requires/1)
prologNoArity: s.functor is required for reader prolog: name the facts read as Name/Arity (requires/1)
prologPrefix: s.functor is required for reader prolog: name the facts read as Name/Arity (requires/1)
prologSuffix: s.functor is required for reader prolog: name the facts read as Name/Arity (requires/1)
prologNumber: s.functor is required for reader prolog: name the facts read as Name/Arity (requires/1)
prologBadArg: s.arg must be the 1-based argument of each fact that holds the member
prologFractionArg: s.arg must be the 1-based argument of each fact that holds the member
prologSelect: s (reader prolog) does not take select; it takes reader, file, functor, arg
s.select does not apply to reader prolog
